meta.study_type: Wheat phenology and Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 fusion research
meta.scope_note: The uploaded Haridwar outputs support wheat phenology, sensor-fusion, transition-date, cloud-gap robustness and model-evaluation analysis. They do not contain Haridwar irrigation/water-deficit outputs, so the dashboard does not fabricate an irrigation advisory.

analysis_notes.title: Fusion LOSO result
analysis_notes.text: The best S1+S2 LOSO model is RandomForest with 64.4% accuracy and macro-F1 0.493.

analysis_notes.title: Cloud-gap robustness
analysis_notes.text: At 60% additional optical masking, the selected fusion model retains macro-F1 0.424 versus 0.267 for the selected S2-only model. This experiment supports the value of retaining SAR during optical gaps.

analysis_notes.title: Natural cloud gaps
analysis_notes.text: Usable optical fractions are 60.5% for 2023-24 and 73.3% for 2024-25.

analysis_notes.title: Class imbalance warning
analysis_notes.text: The labelled dataset contains only 1 Senescence/Harvest sample, so macro metrics and the confusion matrix are more informative than accuracy alone.

analysis_notes.title: Transition timing
analysis_notes.text: Double Logistic has mean interval error 8.5 d and 83.3% of transition estimates fall within 14 days of the published reference interval.
